name: my-chatgpt-web
description: V2 Gemini chatbot with memory, multimodal input, auto routing, tool use, and summary features

scripts.diagram:svg: mmdc -p puppeteer-config.json -c mermaid.config.json -i system-architecture.mmd -o system-architecture.svg -b transparent
scripts.diagram:png: mmdc -p puppeteer-config.json -c mermaid.config.json -i system-architecture.mmd -o system-architecture.png -b white -w 2200
scripts.diagram:render: npm run diagram:svg && npm run diagram:png
